description: This file defines Express routes for order-related operations in a restaurant web application, including placing an order and retrieving order status. It interacts with a database to store and fetch order data and associated items.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new order, validating input, calculating total price, inserting order and items into the database, and returning order details.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve order details by ID, including status and fulfillment info.
